name: Axtria — Life Sciences AI Analytics Platform | CIO Command Center

1.content:
# 🏛️ Axtria — Life Sciences AI Analytics Platform
## CIO Command Center | Full-Stack Observability

**APM · Distributed Tracing · K8s/EKS · MSSQL/PostgreSQL · IIS · Salesforce — single pane of glass**

6.content: ## 📡 Application & Service Health — APM · HTTP Errors · Request Tracing

7.query:
data record(service="Axtria InsightsMAx.ai", error_rate=0.18, requests=28420),
     record(service="Axtria DataMAx", error_rate=0.42, requests=19840),
     record(service="Axtria SalesIQ", error_rate=0.09, requests=24100),
     record(service="Axtria MarketingIQ", error_rate=0.31, requests=11200),
     record(service="Axtria CustomerIQ", error_rate=0.27, requests=9870),
     record(service="IIS App Gateway", error_rate=0.55, requests=34800),
     record(service="Salesforce Integration", error_rate=0.73, requests=6420),
     record(service="MSSQL Data Service", error_rate=0.12, requests=42300),
     record(service="PostgreSQL Analytics DB", error_rate=0.08, requests=31700),
     record(service="EKS Inference Engine", error_rate=0.19, requests=17600)
| sort error_rate desc
| fieldsKeep service, error_rate, requests
7.title: Error Rate % by Service

8.query:
data record(error_code="HTTP 502 Bad Gateway", count=312),
     record(error_code="HTTP 404 Not Found", count=847),
     record(error_code="HTTP 402 Payment Required", count=43),
     record(error_code="HTTP 500 Internal Server", count=189),
     record(error_code="HTTP 503 Unavailable", count=67),
     record(error_code="Connection Timeout", count=156)
| sort count desc
| fieldsKeep error_code, count
8.title: HTTP Error Distribution

11.content: ## 🔧 Infrastructure — K8s/EKS · MSSQL · PostgreSQL · IIS · Latency by Layer

12.query:
data record(layer="Salesforce API", avg_ms=412),
     record(layer="IIS App Layer", avg_ms=234),
     record(layer="External Data Partners", avg_ms=187),
     record(layer="MSSQL Database", avg_ms=78),
     record(layer="K8s/EKS Pods", avg_ms=89),
     record(layer="Message Queue", avg_ms=34),
     record(layer="Network (Internal)", avg_ms=12),
     record(layer="PostgreSQL Analytics", avg_ms=64)
| sort avg_ms desc
| fieldsKeep layer, avg_ms
12.title: Latency by Layer — App · DB · Network · Downstream

13.query:
data record(db="MSSQL: incentive_comp", query="usp_CalcBonus", avg_ms=143, calls_hr=4200, slow_queries=12),
     record(db="PostgreSQL: forecasting", query="forecast_model_run", avg_ms=234, calls_hr=2100, slow_queries=21),
     record(db="PostgreSQL: patient_data", query="patient_journey_agg", avg_ms=112, calls_hr=9800, slow_queries=8),
     record(db="MSSQL: datamax_core", query="usp_DataIngestion", avg_ms=167, calls_hr=6300, slow_queries=9),
     record(db="MSSQL: territory_mgmt", query="usp_GetTerritoryMap", avg_ms=92, calls_hr=8700, slow_queries=5),
     record(db="MSSQL: pharma_commercial", query="usp_GetSalesData", avg_ms=78, calls_hr=12400, slow_queries=3),

15.query:

     record(status="Pending", pods=4),

16.content: ## 🔍 Distributed Tracing · Dependency Health · Alerts · Salesforce

17.query:
data record(trace_id="TRC-1F6A", flow="IIS → Salesforce API", duration_ms=2310, spans=5, status="Error 502"),
     record(trace_id="TRC-7C4B", flow="IIS → DataMAx → PostgreSQL", duration_ms=1842, spans=12, status="Slow"),
     record(trace_id="TRC-8E2D", flow="MarketingIQ → DataMAx → External", duration_ms=943, spans=14, status="Slow"),
     record(trace_id="TRC-5B9C", flow="CustomerIQ → PostgreSQL → EKS", duration_ms=723, spans=11, status="Success"),
     record(trace_id="TRC-3D8E", flow="SalesIQ → EKS → MSSQL", duration_ms=487, spans=9, status="Success"),
     record(trace_id="TRC-9A2F", flow="IIS → InsightsMAx → MSSQL", duration_ms=312, spans=8, status="Success"),
     record(trace_id="TRC-2G7H", flow="IIS → IncentiveComp → MSSQL", duration_ms=234, spans=6, status="Success")
| fieldsKeep trace_id, flow, duration_ms, spans, status
17.title: Distributed Trace Summary — IIS · App · DB · K8s · Salesforce

18.query:
data record(severity="Critical", count=4),
     record(severity="Warning", count=17),
     record(severity="Info", count=32),
     record(severity="Resolved (24h)", count=28)
| sort count desc

20.query:
data record(timestamp=now()-3m, event="HTTP 502 — Salesforce API timeout on CustomerIQ integration", severity="Critical", service="Salesforce Integration"),
     record(timestamp=now()-8m, event="K8s Pod CrashLoopBackOff — datamax-worker-7d9b (OOMKilled)", severity="Warning", service="EKS/DataMAx"),
     record(timestamp=now()-14m, event="Slow DB query usp_CalcBonus > 2s on MSSQL incentive_comp", severity="Warning", service="MSSQL"),
     record(timestamp=now()-19m, event="HTTP 404 spike — 312 errors on /api/v2/insights endpoint (InsightsMAx)", severity="Warning", service="InsightsMAx API"),
     record(timestamp=now()-27m, event="Intermittent disconnect — IIS App Pool recycled (3 occurrences in 30m)", severity="Warning", service="IIS Gateway"),
     record(timestamp=now()-34m, event="Trace TRC-7C4B — DataMAx → PostgreSQL latency 1842ms (SLA breach)", severity="Critical", service="DataMAx"),
     record(timestamp=now()-41m, event="PostgreSQL forecast_model_run 234ms avg — 21 slow queries/hr detected", severity="Info", service="PostgreSQL"),
     record(timestamp=now()-48m, event="K8s Pod datamax-worker-7d9b OOMKilled — 512MB memory limit exceeded", severity="Warning", service="EKS"),
     record(timestamp=now()-56m, event="HTTP 502 — Salesforce webhook callback failed (retry 3/3 exhausted)", severity="Critical", service="Salesforce Integration"),
     record(timestamp=now()-63m, event="Auto-remediation: IIS App Pool recycled — service restored in 4.2s", severity="Info", service="IIS Gateway"),
     record(timestamp=now()-71m, event="Alert resolved: InsightsMAx API error rate back to 0.18% (was 1.2%)", severity="Info", service="InsightsMAx"),
     record(timestamp=now()-84m, event="Deployment: axtria-salesiq v3.12.1 rolled out to EKS (canary 10%)", severity="Info", service="SalesIQ"),
     record(timestamp=now()-97m, event="Alert fired: Salesforce API P99 latency > 2000ms threshold breached", severity="Warning", service="Salesforce")
| fieldsKeep timestamp, event, severity, service
20.title: Recent Events — Errors · Traces · K8s · DB · Deployments
